topic: Ole Miss after the 24-17 loss at Oklahoma: Pete Golding's Tuesday injury update and Senior Day against Wofford
angle: The playoff is gone; Golding said after Sunday's game that the fourth loss kind of seals the fate from a playoff standpoint. Lead with the news from his Tuesday Wofford preview press conference: the running back who had season-ending surgery in Dallas last week, the high ankle injury that makes another back a game-time decision at best, who is shut down until the Egg Bowl or the bowl game, and the senior class he said is 40 and 11 with a chance to become the winningest class in program history by winning three more.
